units.source_text: 夫人是东京人，这是先生和夫人自己曾经告诉过我的。

en.t: Madam was from Tokyo, as both Sensei and Madam herself had once told me.

units.source_text: 夫人说过：“说起来，我算是个‘混血儿’呢。”

en.t: Madam had said, "Come to think of it, I suppose I am a kind of mixed-blood."

units.source_text: 因为她的父亲大概出生在鸟取（或其他地方，母亲却生在那时还叫江户的市谷，所以她才半开玩笑地这样说。

en.t: She said it half in jest because her father had probably been born in Tottori, or somewhere like that, while her mother had been born in Ichigaya when it was still called Edo.

units.source_text: 而先生则是出身于相距甚远的新潟县。

en.t: Sensei, however, came from Niigata Prefecture, far away in a completely different direction.

units.source_text: 因此，如果夫人在先生学生时代就认识先生了，那么显然不是同乡的关系。

en.t: So if Madam had known Sensei when he was a student, it was clearly not through any connection as people from the same hometown.

units.source_text: 可是夫人红了脸，似乎不想再说下去，我也不好深究了。

en.t: But Madam blushed and seemed unwilling to say any more, so I too felt unable to press her further.

units.source_text: 从认识先生到先生去世，我在各种各样的问题上接触到了先生的思想和情操，

en.t: From the time I became acquainted with Sensei until his death, I came into contact with his thoughts and feelings on all sorts of matters,

units.source_text: 但对他结婚时的情形却一无所知。

en.t: but I knew nothing at all about the circumstances of his marriage.

units.source_text: 有时，我从善意的角度来看这个问题，我想，先生是长辈，故而对于给年轻人讲自己的情爱史抱着谨慎的态度。

en.t: At times, I looked at the matter charitably and thought that, because Sensei was my elder, he was cautious about telling a young man the story of his own love affairs.

units.source_text: 有时，我也从消极的角度来想，觉得无论是先生还是夫人，和我比起来，

en.t: At other times, I took a more negative view and felt that both Sensei and Madam, compared with me,

units.source_text: 他们都是在上一个时代的旧习俗里长大成人的，

en.t: had grown up within the old customs of an earlier age,

units.source_text: 所以一涉及这类情史，就没有勇气坦率地暴露自己了。

en.t: and therefore lacked the courage to reveal themselves frankly when it came to such romantic matters.

units.source_text: 不过，这些仅仅是我的推测而已。

en.t: Still, these were merely my own guesses.

units.source_text: 但无论是哪种推测，毋庸置疑的是，他们两人的结合，必定是一段非常动人的罗曼史。

en.t: But whatever the guess, there was no doubt in my mind that the union of those two must have been a very moving romance.
